messages:
Jo Chen (CEO): Thanks for joining the all-hands today. Quick follow-ups from the compliance segment — can folks spell out owners/next-steps for: SOC2 evidence collection, ISO timeline, KMS BYOK pilot schedule, audit log retention policy for Private customers, and the VPC/private-link deployment checklist? Trying to turn Qs into action items before EOW.

Ava (Security): TL;DR: I can own SOC2 evidence bundling + audit log retention proposal. Will need help from Legal on control language and Platform on log export paths.

Priya (Legal): Happy to review control narratives. For SOC2 evidence we need a named owner per control and a tracker with artifact links (policies, runbooks, screenshots). Suggest using the compliance workspace we started last quarter.

Liam (Infra): For VPC / privatelink checklist: network architecture diagram, flow logs onboarding, private DNS, and KMS access path. I can draft the checklist but need Diego to confirm the runtime side for token storage.

Diego (Platform): I’ll validate runtime changes. Two quick notes: (1) Audit logs from Dedicated must be exportable to customer S3/GCS within 24h; (2) BYOK needs KMS-rotation docs and a short migration path — otherwise customers hit a deadlock during rotation.

Ava (Security): On retention: proposing default 90 days for high-fidelity request logs, 365 days for metadata-level records (config changes, rollouts). Customers on enterprise plans can request longer retention via contract addendums.

Jo Chen (CEO): That matches the ask from the sales SRE leads. Can we put concrete owners + deadlines? Who will own the SOC2 artifact tracker?

Ava (Security): I will. Owner: Ava (Security). Deadline: draft tracker and initial artifact list by 1992110400 (end of this week).

Priya (Legal): I’ll review the tracker and provide control language by 1992111200 (Monday morning).

Liam (Infra): I’ll produce the VPC checklist draft by 1992110800 (Friday EOD). Will include specific terraform snippets and a sample network diagram. Sample snippet: ```hcl
resource "aws_flow_log" "redwood_vpc" {
  log_group_name = "/redwood/vpc/flow"
  traffic_type   = "ALL"
}
```

Diego (Platform): I’ll validate the runtime items and confirm the audit-log export interface by 1992111000 (Friday night). Also start a short playbook for BYOK onboarding; ETA 1992111600 (next Tue).

Ava (Security): Regarding ISO — we’re still scoping the gap assessment. Research partner shortlisted; running cost estimates now. Expect a gap report by 1992116000 (two weeks).

Jo Chen (CEO): Great. Please add owners & deadlines to the compliance workspace and ping me if you need exec support. Also include a short customer-facing FAQ for BYOK and log retention.

ops-bot: Recording and transcript uploaded: https://redwood.internal/recordings/1992109876 (access: redwood.com SSO).

Priya (Legal): Quick compliance note: any customer-requested retention beyond 3 years requires privacy team sign-off — flag those early.

Liam (Infra): One blocker: for Private on-prem installs, HSM integration testing requires VIN access from a handful of customers — need security clearance flow. Will file an ops request.

Ava (Security): Filing a cross-team ticket now: #COM-523 — will include test fixtures and list of customers for VIN/HSM testing.

Jo Chen (CEO): Thanks all. Can we reconvene next Tuesday for a 15-min sync? If owners hit blockers, raise in #leadership-ops.

Diego (Platform): Ack — adding calendar invite for next Tue 10am PT.

Ava (Security): Thanks — I’ll post the SOC2 tracker link here when ready. :thumbsup:
